headline: Sterlite Technologies Limited: Allotment of Securities
sum: Sterlite Technologies allotted 25,728,500 securities via Qualified Institution Placement (QIP) on 1 July 2026, expanding its equity capital base through institutional investor participation.
detail: Sterlite Technologies Limited conducted a Qualified Institution Placement resulting in the allotment of 25,728,500 equity securities. The allotment was approved at a Board meeting held on 1 July 2026 and intimated to the NSE on the same date. The specific issue price, number of shareholders, and net capital raised are not disclosed in the exchange filing; however, QIP issuances under SEBI (ICDR) Regulations 2018 permit institutional investors (mutuals, insurance companies, pension funds) to subscribe at market-linked or negotiated prices without requiring shareholder approval if within prescribed thresholds.
